project.name: YOFC IOT Runtime
project.description: Single OSGi bundle embedding all yofc-iot runtime dependencies: fastjson2, javacan, vertx-* (auth, bridge, mqtt, web, http-proxy, tcp-eventbus, sql clients), and digitalpetri state machines.
